# Remaining-title review

2026-10-22, Europe/Warsaw. Reviewed 968 source records (964 original records plus four corrected splits): 716 newly scored works, 156 new hard exclusions, 52 existing-work matches, 27 within-batch duplicates, three non-book references and **14 unresolved records**. Source titles are not added from external research. Auxiliary-page coverage and the blocked Bookshop source remain incomplete.

## Evidence and limits

Scores are editorial judgments with low confidence unless a specific prior assessment supports more. All new density estimates are low confidence: source descriptions, bibliographic records, selected publisher contents/excerpts and targeted independent checks do not establish whole-book paragraph-level learning yield. No full-text reading or catalog-wide density recalibration is claimed. Existing density estimates remain uncalibrated unless an explicit change is stated.

The four authorless titles raised with the user remain unresolved; the user does not know the intended authors. Other ambiguous identities and two unresolved production histories are also retained without numerical scores. Unknown evidence is not a hard exclusion.

The ten raw attainments use each criterion’s own maximum. Only E/S/D are squared. T11/T12/H13/P14/O15 remain separate; sorting uses unrounded totals. Veto totals are counterfactual and suspend only the veto. Hard exclusions have no new scores. General topic preference or a low score is not an extra exclusion.

Amazon counts come from one title-and-author-matched product. Failed product searches and blocked pages leave counts unknown and O15=0. Search-result counts and Shortform scores are not reader aggregates. German product links are edition locators; local stock was not verified. Where no product is verified, the title link is explicitly a paperback search, not an invented product.

[Research metadata](../data/remaining_261021/enriched.json) · [Goodreads captures](../data/remaining_261021/goodreads.json) · [Amazon attempts](../data/remaining_261021/ratings.json) · [Final checks](../data/remaining_261021/final-checks.mjs). The web-gates JSON files preserve the targeted research captures.
